Colour/font/pause/audio extended control codes are consumed as documented no-ops; see the module's 'Deliberately out of scope' docs.

SpriteCB_PokemonLogoShine.reason: Not modeled (option b, documented fidelity delta). The shine is created with oam.objMode = ST_OAM_OBJ_WINDOW (title_screen.c:536): it never draws its own pixels but defines an OBJWIN region that, with WININ/WINOUT + BLDCNT_TGT1_BG2|BLDCNT_EFFECT_LIGHTEN + BLDY=12 (case 4, lines 646-660), lightens BG2 as the mask sweeps -- a Phase1-only effect running while only BG2 is displayed, before clouds/version/press-start exist and before the settled Phase3 cloud alpha blend (line 750) replaces that BLDCNT. The GBA runs one BLDCNT effect per frame and rendering's EffectsConfig mirrors that (one ColorEffect/frame), so the windowed BG2 lighten cannot be composited into the same settled frame whose color effect is already the alpha blend. Drawing it as an opaque OBJ would be visibly wrong; so it is omitted, along with its bg-color flash and the two later Phase1 re-triggers. See crates/pokeemerald-rs/src/title.rs module docs, 'Documented fidelity deltas'.
